# DocDuniya API reference

<!-- Generated by `npm run openapi` from the route sources. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every operation the backend serves, with the exact request fields it validates. Read the [frontend integration guide](README.md) first: it explains sign-in, headers, errors, pagination, roles and the screen-by-screen workflows that use these endpoints.

- Base URL: `<API host>/api/v1`. Paths below are relative to it.
- **Auth:** *Public* needs no session; *Signed in* needs the access cookie or `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`.
- **Idempotency-Key:** commands marked *required* need a fresh UUID per user action (reuse it only when retrying the same request).
- **Permissions in code path** lists the permission codes found in the handler’s service code. *org* codes come from the caller’s roles in that organization (`GET /me/workspaces`), *platform* codes from the platform admin role (`GET /auth/me`), *patient authority* from owning the patient profile or being its reviewed representative. The list is extracted automatically: a route needs the code that matches the caller and action (for example check-in needs `appointments.manage`, starting a visit `clinical.write`), and some codes are checked on other people (a doctor’s own affiliation). Use it to decide which screens to show; always handle `403` and `404` as well.
- Request bodies are strict: unknown fields are rejected with `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`. Fields marked *yes* are required. "Minimal example" bodies contain the required fields only, with placeholder values.
- Every success response is `{ "success": true, "data": … }`; commands return `data: { "id", "version" }` unless noted.

Operations: 407.

## Health

### `GET /health`

Get health.

**Auth:** Public

### `GET /health/ready`

Get readiness.

> Readiness: the database answers and is a replica set (transactions are required). Load balancers should route traffic only while this returns 200; liveness stays on GET /health.

**Auth:** Public

## Authentication

### `POST /auth/register`

Register.

**Auth:** Public

**Body** (`application/json`)

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `email` | email | yes | max 254 chars |
| `password` | string | yes | 8–128 chars; pattern `[A-Z] and [a-z] and [0-9] and [^A-Za-z0-9]` |

<details><summary>Minimal example</summary>

```json
{
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "password": "examplex"
}
```

</details>

## Organization access

### `GET /me/workspaces`

My workspaces.

> The signed-in account's provider workspaces, for navigation: each current membership with its organization, facility scope, roles and the union of their permission codes, plus pending invitations. It uses the same validity rules as `authorizeOrganization`, so a permission listed here is one the server currently grants; every command still re-checks it.

Record inpatient observation.

**Auth:** Signed in · **Idempotency-Key:** required · **Permissions in code path:** `clinical.sign` (org), `nursing.write` (org)

**Path:** `organizationId`, `admissionId`

**Body** (`application/json`)

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `category` | "VITAL_SIGNS" \| "EXAM" \| "SOCIAL" | yes |  |
| `code` | object | yes |  |
| `code.text` | string | yes | 1–500 chars |

| `code.codings[].code` | string | yes | 1–100 chars |
| `code.codings[].display` | string | yes | 1–200 chars |
| `code.codings[].version` | string |  | max 60 chars |
| `value` | object (one of 4 variants) | yes |  |
| *value variant 1 (type = "QUANTITY")* | object |  | Send one variant |
| `value.type` | "QUANTITY" | yes |  |
| `value.value` | string | yes | pattern `^-?\d{1,9}(\.\d{1,6})?$` |
| `value.unit` | string | yes | 1–40 chars |
| *value variant 2 (type = "TEXT")* | object |  | Send one variant |
| `value.type` | "TEXT" | yes |  |
| `value.text` | string | yes | 1–4000 chars |
| *value variant 3 (type = "CODE")* | object |  | Send one variant |
| `value.type` | "CODE" | yes |  |
| `value.code` | object | yes |  |
| `value.code.text` | string | yes | 1–500 chars |
| `value.code.codings` | object[] |  | max 5 items; default [] |
| `value.code.codings[].system` | string | yes | 1–200 chars |
| `value.code.codings[].code` | string | yes | 1–100 chars |
| `value.code.codings[].display` | string | yes | 1–200 chars |
| `value.code.codings[].version` | string |  | max 60 chars |
| *value variant 4 (type = "BOOLEAN")* | object |  | Send one variant |
| `value.type` | "BOOLEAN" | yes |  |
| `value.value` | boolean | yes |  |
| `effectiveAt` | date-time (ISO 8601) | yes |  |
| `status` | "PRELIMINARY" \| "FINAL" |  | default "FINAL" |
| `referenceRange` | object |  |  |
| `referenceRange.low` | string |  | pattern `^-?\d{1,9}(\.\d{1,6})?$` |
| `referenceRange.high` | string |  | pattern `^-?\d{1,9}(\.\d{1,6})?$` |
| `referenceRange.unit` | string |  | 1–40 chars |
| `referenceRange.text` | string |  | 1–200 chars |
| `interpretation` | "NORMAL" \| "LOW" \| "HIGH" \| "CRITICAL_LOW" \| "CRITICAL_HIGH" \| "ABNORMAL" |  |  |

<details><summary>Minimal example</summary>

```json
{
  "category": "VITAL_SIGNS",
  "code": {
    "text": "example"
  },
  "value": {
    "type": "QUANTITY",
    "value": "example",
    "unit": "example"
  },
  "effectiveAt": "2026-12-01T10:00:00.000Z"
}
```

</details>

## Patient identity

### `POST /patients/merge-requests`

> Either the surviving identity's owner (claiming a record a provider created for them) or a provider holding both registrations requests a merge. Only unclaimed records merge: an account owner's identity can never be absorbed into another account.

**Auth:** Signed in · **Idempotency-Key:** required · **Permissions in code path:** `patients.register` (org), `profile.update` (patient authority)

**Body** (`application/json`)

| `targetPatientId` | ObjectId | yes |  |
| `evidence` | string | yes | 20–2000 chars |

```json
  "targetPatientId": "665f1c2e9b1e4a0012345678",
  "evidence": "example text for thi"
}
```

</details>

## Payment webhooks

### `POST /webhooks/payments/razorpay/{merchantAccountId}`

Receive webhook.

> Verifies the raw bytes, durably inserts a deduplicated inbox row, then acknowledges. Returns false when the signature is invalid. Persistence failures propagate so the gateway retries.

**Auth:** Public

**Path:** `merchantAccountId`

**Body:** none (send no body or `{}`).
